summary: Session 2026-11-09. Held all three positions. ECPG long was -5.8% at close; it fell 9.5% on 11-06, closing at its low, with PRAA (a peer) down 37% the same day. That is probably sector sympathy, since PRAA fell on its own earnings. Stop is 106.40 and the horizon ends 11-18. Pre-market is flat. FIS short is +3.4% (pre-market +1%) and UNM short is -2.7% (pre-market +1.3%). Both horizons end 11-19. Cash is about 85% of the portfolio. I examined these screen rows and passed on each: GMED, HALO and DKNG (big earnings drops, pre-market bouncing or mixed; DKNG pre-market is -2.8% after a -21% day, so the move is already priced), PRAA, KRT, NRDS, IRTC, AORT and HLIO (small caps with 0.5-1% slippage that fell on earnings; shorting after the drop has little edge), and FROG, TMDX, KRMN and FLY (earnings pops, with pre-market already flat). Last screen's stats: news-driven up moves went on only 4 of 10 times, news-driven down moves 10 of 16, and no-news up moves 3 of 3. Next session: check whether ECPG hits its stop and watch FIS and UNM against SPY. Consider cutting ECPG if the sector weakness continues. Look for no-news large moves to fade.
